question.question: What is the primary purpose of a model registry in an MLOps pipeline?

options.text: To automatically retrain models when data drift is detected
To store, version, and manage the lifecycle of trained model artifacts
To monitor real-time prediction latency and throughput
To generate synthetic training data for model augmentation

question.explanation: A model registry is a centralized repository for storing, versioning, and managing trained model artifacts throughout their lifecycle. It enables tracking model versions, metadata, and stages (staging, production, archived), which is essential for reproducibility, governance, and CI/CD in MLOps. The other options describe separate MLOps components: automated retraining (pipelines/orchestration), monitoring (observability), and data generation (data engineering).
